zh-TW.text: 俯瞰C02交付的功能分割，再展開四條封裝路線。
zh-TW.english: Fly over the functional partition delivered by C02, then open four packaging routes.

zh-TW.text: 本課比較矽中介層、扇出重佈線、局部矽橋，以及垂直混合鍵合。
zh-TW.english: This lesson compares a silicon interposer, fan-out redistribution, a local silicon bridge, and vertical hybrid bonding.

zh-TW.text: 它們是可選擇且有時可刻意組合的架構，不是四道必經製造工序。
zh-TW.english: They are architectural choices, sometimes deliberately combined, rather than four compulsory manufacturing steps.

zh-TW.text: 本課交付有理由與未解風險的選型，詳細凸塊與電源網路映射留給C04。
zh-TW.english: Our deliverable is a justified selection with unresolved risks, while detailed bump and power-net mapping belongs to C04.

zh-TW.text: 先降落到需求看板，再欣賞各種結構。
zh-TW.english: Descend to the requirement board before looking at attractive structures.

zh-TW.text: 原創假設案例要求單向每秒至少120GB、分配給動態鏈路的功率不超過5W，以及封裝高度不超過2mm。
zh-TW.english: Our invented example requires at least 120 gigabytes per second in one direction, no more than five watts of allocated dynamic link power, and a package height within two millimetres.

zh-TW.text: 另須在第18週前完成資格驗證，並具備足夠冷卻證據。
zh-TW.english: It also requires qualification by week eighteen and adequate cooling evidence.

zh-TW.text: 必要條件失敗或未知，不能靠偏好分數很高來抵銷。
zh-TW.english: A failed or unknown mandatory requirement cannot be cancelled by a high preference score.

zh-TW.text: 傾斜模型，露出讓相鄰晶粒共用布線區的矽中介層。
zh-TW.english: Tilt the model to reveal a silicon interposer connecting neighbouring dies across a shared routing area.

zh-TW.text: 它可支援大量密集連線，包括邏輯到記憶體，但實際堆疊與垂直連接依平台而定。
zh-TW.english: This can support many dense connections, including logic-to-memory links, but the exact stack and vertical connections are platform specific.

zh-TW.text: CoWoS-S是矽中介層的例子，整個CoWoS家族也包含其他互連結構。
zh-TW.english: CoWoS-S is a silicon-interposer example; the wider CoWoS family also contains different interconnect constructions.

zh-TW.text: 評分之前，先問所選實作是否符合布線、組裝、測試與供應限制。
zh-TW.english: Ask whether the chosen implementation meets routing, assembly, test, and supply constraints before assigning it a score.

zh-TW.text: 沿銅重佈線層滑行，看連線延伸到個別晶粒邊緣之外。
zh-TW.english: Glide above copper redistribution layers that extend connections beyond individual die edges.

zh-TW.text: 扇出是一系列結構，有些變體之後仍會安裝在基板上。
zh-TW.english: Fan-out is a family of constructions, and some variants are subsequently mounted on a substrate.

zh-TW.text: 圖像是教學重建，不是實測截面，也不是某供應商的製程配方。
zh-TW.english: The drawing is an explanatory reconstruction, not a measured cross-section or a recipe for one supplier.

zh-TW.text: 在相同系統需求下，比較可用布線密度、封裝變形、組裝公差與已驗證產能。
zh-TW.english: Compare available routing density, package deformation, assembly tolerances, and qualified capacity under the same system requirements.

zh-TW.text: 沿兩個相對的晶粒邊緣移動，展開連接區下方的局部矽橋。
zh-TW.english: Move along two facing die edges and expose a local silicon bridge beneath their connection region.

zh-TW.text: 矽橋把精細布線集中在選定跨越處，不必讓整個共用布線平面都採同一結構。
zh-TW.english: A bridge concentrates fine wiring at selected crossings instead of requiring the entire shared routing plane to use that construction.

zh-TW.text: 晶粒邊緣、基板布線、供電與擺放公差仍須相互匹配。
zh-TW.english: The die edges, substrate routing, power delivery, and placement tolerances still need a compatible design.

zh-TW.text: 不要假定每種矽橋相同或都沒有垂直通孔，平台變體必須逐一確認。
zh-TW.english: Do not assume every bridge is identical or lacks vertical vias; platform variants must be checked individually.

zh-TW.text: 抬起一片晶粒，展現含銅接點與介電質鍵合表面的混合鍵合界面。
zh-TW.english: Lift one die to reveal a hybrid-bond interface with copper contacts and dielectric bonding surfaces.

zh-TW.text: 垂直整合可縮短部分連接，但表面準備、對準、測試存取與冷卻成為選型要點。
zh-TW.english: Vertical integration can shorten selected connections, while surface preparation, alignment, test access, and cooling become essential selection questions.

zh-TW.text: 經驗證的堆疊本身也可能再整合進中介層或扇出封裝。
zh-TW.english: A qualified stack may itself be integrated into an interposer or fan-out package.

zh-TW.text: 這種組合需要自己的證據，不代表所有封裝製程都變成必選。
zh-TW.english: That combination needs its own evidence and does not make every available packaging process mandatory.

zh-TW.text: 回到標為I、F、B、H的四個假想實作，它們不是各架構家族的普遍排名。
zh-TW.english: Return to four fictional implementations labelled I, F, B, and H, not universal rankings of their architecture families.

zh-TW.text: 在相同且明示的條件下，其預估有效容量依序為每秒144、112、128、160GB。
zh-TW.english: Their forecast useful capacities are respectively 144, 112, 128, and 160 gigabytes per second under identical declared conditions.

zh-TW.text: F未達120門檻，H則因缺少冷卻證據而待定。
zh-TW.english: F misses our 120 threshold, while H remains pending because its cooling evidence is missing.

zh-TW.text: 其餘需求的預估結果明確記錄後，I與B才可進入暫定比較。
zh-TW.english: I and B may enter a provisional comparison only after the remaining requirement forecasts are explicitly recorded.

zh-TW.text: 放大成本帳，數字是每次組裝投入的假想成本單位。
zh-TW.english: Zoom into a cost ledger whose numbers are invented accounting units per assembly attempt.

zh-TW.text: I每次210且最終通過率0.90，每個合格品約233.33；B則為190除以0.95，得到200。
zh-TW.english: I costs 210 with a final passing fraction of 0.90, giving about 233.33 per accepted unit, while B gives 190 divided by 0.95, or 200.

zh-TW.text: 若B降至0.80，每個合格品成本升為237.50，成本排序便反轉。
zh-TW.english: If B falls to 0.80, its accepted-unit cost rises to 237.50 and the cost ranking reverses.

zh-TW.text: 供應商也須提出相容設計規則、測試覆蓋、材料與交付產能的證據。
zh-TW.english: A supplier must also substantiate compatible design rules, test coverage, materials, and delivery capacity.

zh-TW.text: 俯瞰暫定可行候選I與B的偏好矩陣。
zh-TW.english: Look down on a preference matrix for the provisionally feasible I and B candidates.

zh-TW.text: 明示的效能、風險、成本與占地權重為0.4、0.3、0.2、0.1，示例分數是3.2與3.5。
zh-TW.english: Our declared performance, risk, cost, and footprint weights are 0.4, 0.3, 0.2, and 0.1, giving illustrative scores of 3.2 and 3.5.

zh-TW.text: 在這些主觀評級下偏好B，但提高效能權重可能反轉排序。
zh-TW.english: B is preferred under these subjective ratings, but a stronger performance emphasis can reverse the ordering.

zh-TW.text: 應公布評級定義與敏感度，不應宣稱矽橋封裝永遠獲勝。
zh-TW.english: Publish the rating definitions and sensitivity, not a claim that bridge packaging always wins.

zh-TW.text: 拉遠到決策紀錄，將每項需求連到證據、假設、負責人與下一次檢查。
zh-TW.english: Pull back to a decision record linking each requirement to evidence, assumptions, an owner, and a next check.

zh-TW.text: 本練習有條件選B，I僅在自己的證據確認後才保留為已驗證替代方案，H維持待定。
zh-TW.english: Select B conditionally in this exercise, retain I as a qualified alternative only if its own evidence is confirmed, and keep H pending.

zh-TW.text: 延遲或冷卻需求改變時，必須重開受影響的決策，而不是默默改分數。
zh-TW.english: A delay or changed cooling requirement must reopen the affected decision rather than silently changing a score.

zh-TW.text: 將核准的架構限制交給C04，再做詳細凸塊與電源網路映射。
zh-TW.english: Pass the approved architecture constraints to C04 for detailed bump and power-net mapping.

ja.text: C02から受け取った機能分割を上空から眺め、四つのパッケージ経路を開きます。
ja.english: Fly over the functional partition delivered by C02, then open four packaging routes.

ja.text: この授業では、シリコンインターポーザー、ファンアウト再配線、局所シリコンブリッジ、垂直ハイブリッド接合を比較します。
ja.english: This lesson compares a silicon interposer, fan-out redistribution, a local silicon bridge, and vertical hybrid bonding.

ja.text: これらは選択肢であり、意図的に組み合わせる場合もありますが、必ず通る四つの製造工程ではありません。
ja.english: They are architectural choices, sometimes deliberately combined, rather than four compulsory manufacturing steps.

ja.text: 成果物は理由と未解決リスクを伴う選択であり、詳細なバンプと電源ネットの対応付けはC04で行います。
ja.english: Our deliverable is a justified selection with unresolved risks, while detailed bump and power-net mapping belongs to C04.

ja.text: 魅力的な構造を見る前に、要求事項のボードへ降ります。
ja.english: Descend to the requirement board before looking at attractive structures.

ja.text: この独自の仮想例では、片方向で毎秒120GB以上、動的リンク電力の割当ては5W以下、パッケージ高さは2mm以内とします。
ja.english: Our invented example requires at least 120 gigabytes per second in one direction, no more than five watts of allocated dynamic link power, and a package height within two millimetres.

ja.text: さらに第18週までの適格性評価完了と、十分な冷却の根拠を求めます。
ja.english: It also requires qualification by week eighteen and adequate cooling evidence.

ja.text: 必須条件の不合格や不明点は、好みの点数が高くても相殺できません。
ja.english: A failed or unknown mandatory requirement cannot be cancelled by a high preference score.

ja.text: モデルを傾け、隣接するダイを共通配線領域でつなぐシリコンインターポーザーを見せます。
ja.english: Tilt the model to reveal a silicon interposer connecting neighbouring dies across a shared routing area.

ja.text: ロジックとメモリの接続を含む多数の高密度接続を支えられますが、実際の積層と垂直接続はプラットフォームごとに異なります。
ja.english: This can support many dense connections, including logic-to-memory links, but the exact stack and vertical connections are platform specific.

ja.text: CoWoS-Sはシリコンインターポーザーの例であり、CoWoS全体には異なる配線構造もあります。
ja.english: CoWoS-S is a silicon-interposer example; the wider CoWoS family also contains different interconnect constructions.

ja.text: 点数を付ける前に、選んだ実装が配線、組立、テスト、供給の制約を満たすか確認します。
ja.english: Ask whether the chosen implementation meets routing, assembly, test, and supply constraints before assigning it a score.

ja.text: 個々のダイの端を越えて接続を広げる銅の再配線層の上を滑空します。
ja.english: Glide above copper redistribution layers that extend connections beyond individual die edges.

ja.text: ファンアウトは構造の一群であり、後から基板に実装する種類もあります。
ja.english: Fan-out is a family of constructions, and some variants are subsequently mounted on a substrate.

ja.text: この図は説明用の再構成であり、測定した断面や特定の供給元の工程処方ではありません。
ja.english: The drawing is an explanatory reconstruction, not a measured cross-section or a recipe for one supplier.

ja.text: 同じシステム要求の下で、利用可能な配線密度、パッケージ変形、組立公差、適格性確認済みの能力を比較します。
ja.english: Compare available routing density, package deformation, assembly tolerances, and qualified capacity under the same system requirements.

ja.text: 向かい合う二つのダイ端に沿って移動し、接続領域の下にある局所シリコンブリッジを展開します。
ja.english: Move along two facing die edges and expose a local silicon bridge beneath their connection region.

ja.text: ブリッジは選んだ横断部に微細配線を集中させ、共通配線面全体を同じ構造にする必要をなくします。
ja.english: A bridge concentrates fine wiring at selected crossings instead of requiring the entire shared routing plane to use that construction.

ja.text: ダイ端、基板配線、給電、配置公差は引き続き整合する設計が必要です。
ja.english: The die edges, substrate routing, power delivery, and placement tolerances still need a compatible design.

ja.text: すべてのブリッジが同一、あるいは垂直ビアを持たないとは考えず、各プラットフォームを確認します。
ja.english: Do not assume every bridge is identical or lacks vertical vias; platform variants must be checked individually.

ja.text: 一枚のダイを持ち上げ、銅接点と誘電体の接合面を持つハイブリッド接合界面を見せます。
ja.english: Lift one die to reveal a hybrid-bond interface with copper contacts and dielectric bonding surfaces.

ja.text: 垂直統合は一部の接続を短縮できますが、表面準備、位置合わせ、テストアクセス、冷却が重要な選択項目になります。
ja.english: Vertical integration can shorten selected connections, while surface preparation, alignment, test access, and cooling become essential selection questions.

ja.text: 適格性を確認した積層を、さらにインターポーザーやファンアウトパッケージへ統合する場合もあります。
ja.english: A qualified stack may itself be integrated into an interposer or fan-out package.

ja.text: その組合せには独自の根拠が必要で、すべての工程を必須にするわけではありません。
ja.english: That combination needs its own evidence and does not make every available packaging process mandatory.

ja.text: I、F、B、Hと名付けた四つの仮想実装へ戻りますが、これは構造群全体の普遍的順位ではありません。
ja.english: Return to four fictional implementations labelled I, F, B, and H, not universal rankings of their architecture families.

ja.text: 同じ明示条件での有効容量予測は、順に毎秒144、112、128、160GBです。
ja.english: Their forecast useful capacities are respectively 144, 112, 128, and 160 gigabytes per second under identical declared conditions.

ja.text: Fは120の基準を満たさず、Hは冷却の根拠がないため保留です。
ja.english: F misses our 120 threshold, while H remains pending because its cooling evidence is missing.

ja.text: IとBも、残る要求の予測結果を明記してから暫定比較に進めます。
ja.english: I and B may enter a provisional comparison only after the remaining requirement forecasts are explicitly recorded.

ja.text: 一回の組立投入当たりの仮想費用単位を記した台帳へ拡大します。
ja.english: Zoom into a cost ledger whose numbers are invented accounting units per assembly attempt.

ja.text: Iは210で最終合格率0.90なので合格品当たり約233.33となり、Bは190を0.95で割って200です。
ja.english: I costs 210 with a final passing fraction of 0.90, giving about 233.33 per accepted unit, while B gives 190 divided by 0.95, or 200.

ja.text: Bが0.80まで下がると合格品当たり237.50になり、費用順位が逆転します。
ja.english: If B falls to 0.80, its accepted-unit cost rises to 237.50 and the cost ranking reverses.

ja.text: 供給元には、整合する設計規則、テスト範囲、材料、納入能力の根拠も求めます。
ja.english: A supplier must also substantiate compatible design rules, test coverage, materials, and delivery capacity.

ja.text: 暫定的に実現可能なIとBの選好行列を上から眺めます。
ja.english: Look down on a preference matrix for the provisionally feasible I and B candidates.

ja.text: 性能、リスク、費用、面積の重みを0.4、0.3、0.2、0.1と明示すると、例示得点は3.2と3.5になります。
ja.english: Our declared performance, risk, cost, and footprint weights are 0.4, 0.3, 0.2, and 0.1, giving illustrative scores of 3.2 and 3.5.

ja.text: この主観的な評価ではBが優先ですが、性能をより重視すると順序が逆転し得ます。
ja.english: B is preferred under these subjective ratings, but a stronger performance emphasis can reverse the ordering.

ja.text: ブリッジが必ず勝つと主張せず、評価の定義と感度を公開します。
ja.english: Publish the rating definitions and sensitivity, not a claim that bridge packaging always wins.

ja.text: 画面を引き、各要求を根拠、仮定、担当者、次の確認に結び付けた決定記録を示します。
ja.english: Pull back to a decision record linking each requirement to evidence, assumptions, an owner, and a next check.

ja.text: この演習ではBを条件付きで選び、Iは独自の根拠が確認できた場合にだけ適格な代替案として残し、Hは保留します。
ja.english: Select B conditionally in this exercise, retain I as a qualified alternative only if its own evidence is confirmed, and keep H pending.

ja.text: 遅延や冷却要求の変更があれば、点数を黙って変更せず、影響する決定を再検討します。
ja.english: A delay or changed cooling requirement must reopen the affected decision rather than silently changing a score.

ja.text: 承認した構造上の制約をC04へ渡し、詳細なバンプと電源ネットの対応付けに進みます。
ja.english: Pass the approved architecture constraints to C04 for detailed bump and power-net mapping.

ko.text: C02에서 받은 기능 분할을 위에서 내려다보고 네 가지 패키지 경로를 펼칩니다.
ko.english: Fly over the functional partition delivered by C02, then open four packaging routes.

ko.text: 이 수업은 실리콘 인터포저, 팬아웃 재배선, 국부 실리콘 브리지, 수직 하이브리드 접합을 비교합니다.
ko.english: This lesson compares a silicon interposer, fan-out redistribution, a local silicon bridge, and vertical hybrid bonding.

ko.text: 이는 선택 가능한 구조이며 의도적으로 조합할 수도 있지만 반드시 거쳐야 하는 네 제조 단계는 아닙니다.

ko.text: 결과물은 근거와 미해결 위험을 담은 선택이며 상세 범프와 전원 네트 매핑은 C04에서 다룹니다.

ko.text: 매력적인 구조를 보기 전에 요구사항 보드로 내려갑니다.
ko.english: Descend to the requirement board before looking at attractive structures.

ko.text: 이 독창적인 가상 사례는 단방향 초당120GB 이상, 동적 링크 전력 할당5W 이하, 패키지 높이2mm 이내를 요구합니다.
ko.english: Our invented example requires at least 120 gigabytes per second in one direction, no more than five watts of allocated dynamic link power, and a package height within two millimetres.

ko.text: 또한18주차까지 적격성 평가를 마치고 충분한 냉각 근거를 확보해야 합니다.
ko.english: It also requires qualification by week eighteen and adequate cooling evidence.

ko.text: 필수 조건의 실패나 미확인은 높은 선호 점수로 상쇄할 수 없습니다.
ko.english: A failed or unknown mandatory requirement cannot be cancelled by a high preference score.

ko.text: 모델을 기울여 인접 다이를 공통 배선 영역으로 연결하는 실리콘 인터포저를 드러냅니다.
ko.english: Tilt the model to reveal a silicon interposer connecting neighbouring dies across a shared routing area.

ko.text: 로직과 메모리 연결을 포함한 많은 고밀도 연결을 지원할 수 있지만 실제 적층과 수직 연결은 플랫폼별로 다릅니다.
ko.english: This can support many dense connections, including logic-to-memory links, but the exact stack and vertical connections are platform specific.

ko.text: CoWoS-S는 실리콘 인터포저의 예이며 전체 CoWoS 제품군에는 다른 연결 구조도 있습니다.
ko.english: CoWoS-S is a silicon-interposer example; the wider CoWoS family also contains different interconnect constructions.

ko.text: 점수를 매기기 전에 선택한 구현이 배선, 조립, 시험, 공급 제약을 충족하는지 확인합니다.
ko.english: Ask whether the chosen implementation meets routing, assembly, test, and supply constraints before assigning it a score.

ko.text: 각 다이 가장자리 밖으로 연결을 확장하는 구리 재배선층 위를 이동합니다.
ko.english: Glide above copper redistribution layers that extend connections beyond individual die edges.

ko.text: 팬아웃은 여러 구조의 집합이며 나중에 기판 위에 실장하는 변형도 있습니다.
ko.english: Fan-out is a family of constructions, and some variants are subsequently mounted on a substrate.

ko.text: 그림은 설명용 재구성이지 측정한 단면이나 특정 공급사의 공정 레시피가 아닙니다.
ko.english: The drawing is an explanatory reconstruction, not a measured cross-section or a recipe for one supplier.

ko.text: 동일 시스템 요구사항 아래 가용 배선 밀도, 패키지 변형, 조립 공차, 적격성이 확인된 생산능력을 비교합니다.
ko.english: Compare available routing density, package deformation, assembly tolerances, and qualified capacity under the same system requirements.

ko.text: 마주 보는 두 다이 가장자리를 따라 이동하며 연결 영역 아래 국부 실리콘 브리지를 펼칩니다.
ko.english: Move along two facing die edges and expose a local silicon bridge beneath their connection region.

ko.text: 브리지는 선택한 교차부에 미세 배선을 집중하므로 공통 배선면 전체를 같은 구조로 만들 필요가 없습니다.
ko.english: A bridge concentrates fine wiring at selected crossings instead of requiring the entire shared routing plane to use that construction.

ko.text: 다이 가장자리, 기판 배선, 전력 공급, 배치 공차는 여전히 서로 맞는 설계가 필요합니다.
ko.english: The die edges, substrate routing, power delivery, and placement tolerances still need a compatible design.

ko.text: 모든 브리지가 같거나 수직 비아가 없다고 가정하지 말고 각 플랫폼 변형을 확인합니다.
ko.english: Do not assume every bridge is identical or lacks vertical vias; platform variants must be checked individually.

ko.text: 다이 한 장을 들어 올려 구리 접점과 유전체 접합면으로 된 하이브리드 접합 계면을 보여 줍니다.
ko.english: Lift one die to reveal a hybrid-bond interface with copper contacts and dielectric bonding surfaces.

ko.text: 수직 통합은 일부 연결을 줄일 수 있지만 표면 준비, 정렬, 시험 접근, 냉각이 중요한 선택 항목이 됩니다.
ko.english: Vertical integration can shorten selected connections, while surface preparation, alignment, test access, and cooling become essential selection questions.

ko.text: 적격성이 확인된 적층을 인터포저나 팬아웃 패키지에 다시 통합할 수도 있습니다.
ko.english: A qualified stack may itself be integrated into an interposer or fan-out package.

ko.text: 그 조합에는 자체 근거가 필요하며 모든 패키징 공정이 필수가 되는 것은 아닙니다.
ko.english: That combination needs its own evidence and does not make every available packaging process mandatory.

ko.text: I, F, B, H로 표시한 네 가상 구현으로 돌아가며 이는 구조 제품군 전체의 보편적 순위가 아닙니다.
ko.english: Return to four fictional implementations labelled I, F, B, and H, not universal rankings of their architecture families.

ko.text: 동일하게 명시한 조건의 유효 용량 예측은 순서대로 초당144,112,128,160GB입니다.
ko.english: Their forecast useful capacities are respectively 144, 112, 128, and 160 gigabytes per second under identical declared conditions.

ko.text: F는120기준에 못 미치고 H는 냉각 근거가 없어 보류됩니다.
ko.english: F misses our 120 threshold, while H remains pending because its cooling evidence is missing.

ko.text: I와 B도 나머지 요구사항의 예측 결과를 명확히 기록한 뒤에만 잠정 비교에 들어갑니다.
ko.english: I and B may enter a provisional comparison only after the remaining requirement forecasts are explicitly recorded.

ko.text: 한 번의 조립 투입당 가상 비용 단위를 기록한 장부를 확대합니다.
ko.english: Zoom into a cost ledger whose numbers are invented accounting units per assembly attempt.

ko.text: I는210과 최종 합격률0.90으로 합격품당 약233.33이며 B는190을0.95로 나누어200입니다.
ko.english: I costs 210 with a final passing fraction of 0.90, giving about 233.33 per accepted unit, while B gives 190 divided by 0.95, or 200.

ko.text: B가0.80으로 떨어지면 합격품당 비용은237.50이 되어 비용 순위가 뒤집힙니다.
ko.english: If B falls to 0.80, its accepted-unit cost rises to 237.50 and the cost ranking reverses.

ko.text: 공급사는 호환 설계 규칙, 시험 범위, 재료, 납품능력의 근거도 제시해야 합니다.
ko.english: A supplier must also substantiate compatible design rules, test coverage, materials, and delivery capacity.

ko.text: 잠정적으로 가능한 I와 B의 선호 행렬을 위에서 봅니다.
ko.english: Look down on a preference matrix for the provisionally feasible I and B candidates.

ko.text: 성능, 위험, 비용, 면적 가중치를0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1로 명시하면 예시 점수는3.2와3.5입니다.
ko.english: Our declared performance, risk, cost, and footprint weights are 0.4, 0.3, 0.2, and 0.1, giving illustrative scores of 3.2 and 3.5.

ko.text: 이 주관적 평점에서는 B를 선호하지만 성능을 더 중시하면 순위가 바뀔 수 있습니다.
ko.english: B is preferred under these subjective ratings, but a stronger performance emphasis can reverse the ordering.

ko.text: 브리지 패키징이 항상 이긴다는 주장 대신 평점 정의와 민감도를 공개합니다.
ko.english: Publish the rating definitions and sensitivity, not a claim that bridge packaging always wins.

ko.text: 화면을 뒤로 빼 각 요구사항을 근거, 가정, 담당자, 다음 점검에 연결한 결정 기록을 보여 줍니다.
ko.english: Pull back to a decision record linking each requirement to evidence, assumptions, an owner, and a next check.

ko.text: 이 연습에서는 B를 조건부 선택하고 I는 자체 근거가 확인된 경우에만 적격 대안으로 유지하며 H는 보류합니다.
ko.english: Select B conditionally in this exercise, retain I as a qualified alternative only if its own evidence is confirmed, and keep H pending.

ko.text: 지연이나 냉각 요구 변경 시 점수만 몰래 바꾸지 말고 영향을 받는 결정을 다시 검토해야 합니다.
ko.english: A delay or changed cooling requirement must reopen the affected decision rather than silently changing a score.

ko.text: 승인한 구조 제약을 C04에 넘겨 상세 범프와 전원 네트 매핑을 진행합니다.
ko.english: Pass the approved architecture constraints to C04 for detailed bump and power-net mapping.

zh-CN.text: 俯瞰C02交付的功能划分，再展开四条封装路线。
zh-CN.english: Fly over the functional partition delivered by C02, then open four packaging routes.

zh-CN.text: 本课比较硅中介层、扇出重布线、局部硅桥，以及垂直混合键合。
zh-CN.english: This lesson compares a silicon interposer, fan-out redistribution, a local silicon bridge, and vertical hybrid bonding.

zh-CN.text: 它们是可选择且有时可刻意组合的架构，不是四道必经制造工序。
zh-CN.english: They are architectural choices, sometimes deliberately combined, rather than four compulsory manufacturing steps.

zh-CN.text: 本课交付有理由与未解风险的选型，详细凸块与电源网络映射留给C04。
zh-CN.english: Our deliverable is a justified selection with unresolved risks, while detailed bump and power-net mapping belongs to C04.

zh-CN.text: 先降落到需求看板，再欣赏各种结构。
zh-CN.english: Descend to the requirement board before looking at attractive structures.

zh-CN.text: 原创假设案例要求单向每秒至少120GB、分配给动态链路的功率不超过5W，以及封装高度不超过2mm。
zh-CN.english: Our invented example requires at least 120 gigabytes per second in one direction, no more than five watts of allocated dynamic link power, and a package height within two millimetres.

zh-CN.text: 另须在第18周前完成资格验证，并具备足够冷却证据。
zh-CN.english: It also requires qualification by week eighteen and adequate cooling evidence.

zh-CN.text: 必要条件失败或未知，不能靠偏好分数很高来抵销。
zh-CN.english: A failed or unknown mandatory requirement cannot be cancelled by a high preference score.

zh-CN.text: 倾斜模型，露出让相邻裸片共用布线区的硅中介层。
zh-CN.english: Tilt the model to reveal a silicon interposer connecting neighbouring dies across a shared routing area.

zh-CN.text: 它可支持大量密集连接，包括逻辑到存储器，但实际堆叠与垂直连接依平台而定。
zh-CN.english: This can support many dense connections, including logic-to-memory links, but the exact stack and vertical connections are platform specific.

zh-CN.text: CoWoS-S是硅中介层的例子，整个CoWoS家族也包含其他互连结构。
zh-CN.english: CoWoS-S is a silicon-interposer example; the wider CoWoS family also contains different interconnect constructions.

zh-CN.text: 评分之前，先问所选实现是否符合布线、组装、测试与供应限制。
zh-CN.english: Ask whether the chosen implementation meets routing, assembly, test, and supply constraints before assigning it a score.

zh-CN.text: 沿铜重布线层滑行，看连接延伸到个别裸片边缘之外。
zh-CN.english: Glide above copper redistribution layers that extend connections beyond individual die edges.

zh-CN.text: 扇出是一系列结构，有些变体之后仍会安装在基板上。
zh-CN.english: Fan-out is a family of constructions, and some variants are subsequently mounted on a substrate.

zh-CN.text: 图像是教学重建，不是实测截面，也不是某供应商的工艺配方。
zh-CN.english: The drawing is an explanatory reconstruction, not a measured cross-section or a recipe for one supplier.

zh-CN.text: 在相同系统需求下，比较可用布线密度、封装变形、组装公差与已验证产能。
zh-CN.english: Compare available routing density, package deformation, assembly tolerances, and qualified capacity under the same system requirements.

zh-CN.text: 沿两个相对的裸片边缘移动，展开连接区下方的局部硅桥。
zh-CN.english: Move along two facing die edges and expose a local silicon bridge beneath their connection region.

zh-CN.text: 硅桥把精细布线集中在选定跨越处，不必让整个共用布线平面都采同一结构。
zh-CN.english: A bridge concentrates fine wiring at selected crossings instead of requiring the entire shared routing plane to use that construction.

zh-CN.text: 裸片边缘、基板布线、供电与放置公差仍须相互匹配。
zh-CN.english: The die edges, substrate routing, power delivery, and placement tolerances still need a compatible design.

zh-CN.text: 不要假定每种硅桥相同或都没有垂直通孔，平台变体必须逐一确认。
zh-CN.english: Do not assume every bridge is identical or lacks vertical vias; platform variants must be checked individually.

zh-CN.text: 抬起一片裸片，展现含铜接点与介电质键合表面的混合键合界面。
zh-CN.english: Lift one die to reveal a hybrid-bond interface with copper contacts and dielectric bonding surfaces.

zh-CN.text: 垂直整合可缩短部分连接，但表面准备、对准、测试访问与冷却成为选型要点。
zh-CN.english: Vertical integration can shorten selected connections, while surface preparation, alignment, test access, and cooling become essential selection questions.

zh-CN.text: 经验证的堆叠本身也可能再整合进中介层或扇出封装。
zh-CN.english: A qualified stack may itself be integrated into an interposer or fan-out package.

zh-CN.text: 这种组合需要自己的证据，不代表所有封装工艺都变成必选。
zh-CN.english: That combination needs its own evidence and does not make every available packaging process mandatory.

zh-CN.text: 回到标为I、F、B、H的四个假想实现，它们不是各架构家族的普遍排名。
zh-CN.english: Return to four fictional implementations labelled I, F, B, and H, not universal rankings of their architecture families.

zh-CN.text: 在相同且明示的条件下，其预估有效容量依序为每秒144、112、128、160GB。
zh-CN.english: Their forecast useful capacities are respectively 144, 112, 128, and 160 gigabytes per second under identical declared conditions.

zh-CN.text: F未达120门槛，H则因缺少冷却证据而待定。
zh-CN.english: F misses our 120 threshold, while H remains pending because its cooling evidence is missing.

zh-CN.text: 其余需求的预估结果明确记录后，I与B才可进入暂定比较。
zh-CN.english: I and B may enter a provisional comparison only after the remaining requirement forecasts are explicitly recorded.

zh-CN.text: 放大成本账，数字是每次组装投入的假想成本单位。
zh-CN.english: Zoom into a cost ledger whose numbers are invented accounting units per assembly attempt.

zh-CN.text: I每次210且最终通过率0.90，每个合格品约233.33；B则为190除以0.95，得到200。
zh-CN.english: I costs 210 with a final passing fraction of 0.90, giving about 233.33 per accepted unit, while B gives 190 divided by 0.95, or 200.

zh-CN.text: 若B降至0.80，每个合格品成本升为237.50，成本排序便反转。
zh-CN.english: If B falls to 0.80, its accepted-unit cost rises to 237.50 and the cost ranking reverses.

zh-CN.text: 供应商也须提出兼容设计规则、测试覆盖、材料与交付产能的证据。
zh-CN.english: A supplier must also substantiate compatible design rules, test coverage, materials, and delivery capacity.

zh-CN.text: 俯瞰暂定可行候选I与B的偏好矩阵。
zh-CN.english: Look down on a preference matrix for the provisionally feasible I and B candidates.

zh-CN.text: 明示的性能、风险、成本与占用面积权重为0.4、0.3、0.2、0.1，示例分数是3.2与3.5。
zh-CN.english: Our declared performance, risk, cost, and footprint weights are 0.4, 0.3, 0.2, and 0.1, giving illustrative scores of 3.2 and 3.5.

zh-CN.text: 在这些主观评级下偏好B，但提高性能权重可能反转排序。
zh-CN.english: B is preferred under these subjective ratings, but a stronger performance emphasis can reverse the ordering.

zh-CN.text: 应公布评级定义与敏感度，不应宣称硅桥封装永远获胜。
zh-CN.english: Publish the rating definitions and sensitivity, not a claim that bridge packaging always wins.

zh-CN.text: 拉远到决策记录，将每项需求连到证据、假设、负责人与下一次检查。
zh-CN.english: Pull back to a decision record linking each requirement to evidence, assumptions, an owner, and a next check.

zh-CN.text: 本练习有条件选B，I仅在自己的证据确认后才保留为已验证替代方案，H维持待定。
zh-CN.english: Select B conditionally in this exercise, retain I as a qualified alternative only if its own evidence is confirmed, and keep H pending.

zh-CN.text: 延迟或冷却需求改变时，必须重开受影响的决策，而不是默默改分数。
zh-CN.english: A delay or changed cooling requirement must reopen the affected decision rather than silently changing a score.

zh-CN.text: 将批准的架构限制交给C04，再做详细凸块与电源网络映射。
zh-CN.english: Pass the approved architecture constraints to C04 for detailed bump and power-net mapping.
